propositions: jira"`) must be added to `src/rebar/_config_schema.py` with `_as_choice` coercion to validate allowed keys at config-load time and raise `ConfigError` for unknown values.

No existing consumer (`_load_acli`, `AcliClient` construction sites, differ/apply modules) is rewired in this story; selection infrastructure is isolated and proven equivalent to today's direct construction in unit tests.
